title: Lace shoe
contact_roles: the right hand threads the lace: it keeps the lace between pulls while it feeds the tip at an eyelet (the tip in its fingers isn't in the lace mask) or briefly leaves the picture. From 3.6 s the left hand holds the shoe, even where its fingertips rest on the lace, until it lets go to pull a lace end at the very end. In the first 1.9 s, while the lace comes out of the pile, contact isn't picked up and both hands read as free.
masks_caveat: for the first 1.3 s the lace being pulled from the pile isn't outlined (the tracker had picked the whole pile there). The loose lace ends and the tip in the fingers aren't outlined either.
